review_fix_validation.tested_revision: Review-fix worktree; runtime, fixtures, inventory and bundle identified by SHA-256 below. Commit created after this record.
review_fix_validation.finding: Exposed WebGLLayerObject/CompositionLayerObject constructors could brand unrelated objects allocated with Reflect.construct, so getters succeeded and setters coerced invalid receivers.
review_fix_validation.fix: Remove the branding allocation bases. Brand only after the matching complete layer constructor initializes its object. Keep writers and WeakSets injection-local; publish frozen read-only membership checks for discovery through accessible frame/parent/opener links. Cache discovered checks for previously borrowed retained objects.
review_fix_validation.regressions: Both former ancestor paths, called directly and with Object or a matching public constructor as newTarget, are rejected by both getters and setters before coercion. Cases run on WebGL1/2, inline/immersive and across injected realms. Existing forged-quad case remains. Ended cross-realm layers retain behavior after their iframe is removed.
